items.headline: SPX just moved into the BUY! band
items.detail: Price $0.496 crossed from Accumulate into BUY! within the week — a band change the daily rotation won't announce on its own.
items.framing: SPX moved into the BUY! band this week. A clean "where are we on the rainbow" post even though no per-band fire triggered.
items.checkable: Current price vs the frozen power-law band edges (published model).

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 23th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 58 while the rest average 27 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 58/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: -78% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 26,786 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,311 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: -78% below its long-run trend (BUY! band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.24; price sits -78% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-5.0% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 7.96M SPX. 4w -1.5% · 12w -5% · 26w -11.3%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-5.0% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: SOPR 1.194 — coins moving at a profit
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 1.194: coins that moved on-chain realised a gain on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — profit-taking (SOPR 1.194).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.

items.headline: -1σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 1 = 13th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 1 sits at the 13th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 13th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.
